name: Patch info
description: Show information about applied composer patches.
project_description:
The Patch Info module allows site builders to easily check closed patch on website.

For a full description of the module, visit the project/issue page.

Submit bug reports and feature suggestions, or track changes in the issue queue.

This module can be used for development purpose only. Analyze all the patches and take actions on the patces based on report.

 Features 
 Gives list of the patches in one screen as a summary instead of looking for them in code and visiting drupal.org issue page.

 Post-Installation 
 
 Ensure that the 'Patch Info' module installed. 
 Navigate to admin -> config -> patch information 
 Configure your information in "Patch config form" as shown in screenshot 
 Choose or enter compose.json file location and test if path exists. 
 On successful path test save configuration. 
 Fetch api records post config save. 
 Navigate to /patch-info to analyse patch details. 
 Back to top
